items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: That's when he went with Basie and them.

ctx.x: It says "He settled in California in the mid-1940's." This is in the 1930's, in Chicago. Anyway, Lester Young joined the band at what time? In the spring of 1933, you were saying?

Yeah, it was the spring. Must have been round about April, May, somewhere along in there. And he came in the band and he stayed in the band until November. He stayed with King until November. That's when he went with Basie and them. Then Basie and them went down to Little Rock, Arkansas, and then Fletcher Henderson sent for him.
